missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Лес' stays in the nominative case as the subject. 'Этот' and 'густой' are the agreeing masculine forms, and 'очень' intensifies the description.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. As an inanimate masculine noun, 'лес' is identical in the accusative, here the object of 'люблю'. 'Осенний' agrees in the masculine.
Strategic focus: Genitive after 'около'. 'Леса' is genitive following the preposition 'около', expressing nearness. 'Река' is the nominative subject of 'течёт'.
Strategic focus: Dative of direction. 'К лесу' uses the dative after 'к' to show movement towards the forest. 'Пешком' specifies on foot.
Strategic focus: Instrumental with 'над'. 'Лесом' is the instrumental form after 'над', expressing position above. 'Птицы' is the nominative plural subject of 'летят'.
Strategic focus: Locative prepositional. 'В лесу' uses the special locative ending '-у' after 'в' to mark location. 'Грибов' is genitive plural after 'много'.
Strategic focus: Genitive after 'из'. 'Леса' is genitive following the preposition 'из', expressing movement out of the forest. 'Вечером' is an instrumental adverb of time.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О лесе' uses the ordinary prepositional ending after 'о' to mark the topic of thought, distinct from the locative 'в лесу'. 'Тёмном' agrees.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Леса' is the nominative plural subject of 'растут'. 'Вокруг города' uses the genitive after 'вокруг' to mark surrounding area.
Strategic focus: Dative plural with 'по'. 'Лесам' is the dative plural after 'по', expressing movement through the forests. 'Тихим' agrees in the dative plural.
